mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth, as measured by the quarterly GDP series (GDPC1), indicates a strengthening economic environment that boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs. baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in new housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by > 2% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and supply chain health, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm employment exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines by > 100 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a dual shock of labor market weakness and monetary tightening, which triggers a negative feedback loop in equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise by > 0.2 percentage points in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns.
